canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time

scope_decision: Spearman rank correlation instead of a panel regression (no scipy/statsmodels dependency required); cluster/regime control achieved via a joint-panel block-resampling null instead of per-asset cluster residualization, which is degenerate for the four singleton-cluster assets (TLT, IEF, GLD, DBC)

formation.definition: F(t) = close(t)/close(t-60) - 1, per asset, computed through close t only

rebalance_grid.definition: rebalance dates at session indices 100, 120, 140, ... through the last index with a full forward window available

rank.tie_breaking: average rank (ties split the contested rank positions evenly)

estimand.statistic: pooled Spearman rank correlation between formation rank and forward rank, across all (asset, rebalance date) pairs

bootstrap.base_function: backend/app/research.py:etf12_rotation_bootstrap (joint-panel block-resampling extension of the event-recomputing bootstrap used by RSI/TA Breakout/Wave Pull)
bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled pooled correlation >= observed, plus add-one correction
bootstrap.joint_resampling: the same resampled date-block sequence is applied to all 12 assets simultaneously in each resample, preserving real contemporaneous cross-asset correlation while breaking the specific formation-to-forward temporal link
bootstrap.no_holm_correction: single pooled statistic across the whole panel, not per-asset tests; Holm correction does not apply

gates.cluster_breadth_definition: at least 3 of 6 distinct cluster values must each contribute at least one asset to the top-third formation-rank group at least once across all rebalance dates
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical correlation/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked formation window and holding horizon

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade rank-continuation study
scope_exclusions.no_panel_regression: Spearman rank correlation used instead, by deliberate scope decision
scope_exclusions.no_cluster_residualization: joint-panel block-resampling null used instead, avoiding the singleton-cluster degeneracy
scope_exclusions.no_sleeve_or_executable_expression: any tradeable expression remains a separate, later, separately locked protocol
